description: This file contains JavaScript code for the Mozaik email template builder, including helper functions for generating HTML snippets, managing the Ace editor, and integrating with TinyMCE. It also defines jQuery plugins for manipulating Mozaik components and extracting styles.

methods.name: getThumbnailListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for a list of thumbnail images with labels, used in the template builder.

methods.name: getEditorListHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML for the editor's width resize control.

methods.name: getEditorListElementHTML
methods.description: Builds HTML for a draggable, editable template element with tools.

methods.name: getToolPluginIconListHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for tool plugin icons within a template element.

methods.name: getMozaikInnerHTML
methods.description: Wraps inner content in a div with styling and optional data attributes.

methods.name: getAceHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML structure for the Ace code editor interface.

methods.name: getClearHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for a clear separator element.

methods.name: refreshWidthSet
methods.description: Adjusts the position of width resize handlers based on current width.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the maximum width for template elements and updates handlers.
